post_copy.title: Put baking soda on your hair and watch what happens 😱 (Scalp Detox Secret)
post_copy.caption:
If your hair feels weighed down, thin, or won't grow past your shoulders no matter what shampoo you buy... you don't need another expensive product. You need to detox your suffocated follicles! 🌿✨

Years of dry shampoo, hard water, and heavy oils build up around each hair strand like cement. 

Here is my go-to weekly clarifying scalp recipe:
1️⃣ Mix 1 tbsp of pure baking soda with 2 tbsp of organic coconut oil.
2️⃣ Stir until it forms a creamy paste.
3️⃣ Apply directly along parted wet roots, edges, and brows.
4️⃣ Leave on for 20 minutes before rinsing thoroughly.

The coconut oil deeply nourishes the shaft while the baking soda dissolves stubborn buildup so your scalp can actually breathe and grow thicker hair!

💬 Comment "HAIR" and your HAIR TYPE below, and I'll send you my complete step-by-step mature hair growth guide with the exact botanical routine!

⚠️ Note: Make sure you're following @botaniqueparis so my message can go through to your inbox!
